name: harden-pi-role-agents
title: Harden Pi role-agent dispatch guidance (implement/check)
description: Swap the subagent system the way upstream's own tool did, using only the repo-owned bridge: the four workflow gates written as prose in .trellis/spec/ (content home + fallback), and delivered by the bridge, which relays the dispatched agent name from the subagent tool_call and injects that agent's own manifest - the rule upstream used - so a check child is fed check.jsonl instead of the hardcoded implement.jsonl. Also makes the child inert the way the shipped tool did, so it stops receiving the parent's planning breadcrumb. Measured scope: async children only - a blocking dispatch loads no ambient extensions at all. Zero coupling: no role name, no skill name, no pi-subagents value, nothing upstream-owned edited.
creator: tan
